name: Shijo-Mae
tagline: Tokyo in 25 minutes and Otemachi in 27 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥180,000 to ¥190,000.
summary: The station is in Koto City, served by Yurikamome. Journey times to the main business districts are 27 minutes to Otemachi, 39 minutes to Shinjuku, 38 minutes to Shibuya and 36 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥180,000 to ¥190,000. The station stands 6.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 3.3 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 6.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4.1 m to 7.4 m, a difference of 3.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station, OpenStreetMap records neither a clinic nor a pharmacy. The nearest hospital is 昭和医科大学江東豊洲病院, about 18 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 聖カタリナ病院, about 20 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
congestion: Yurikamome runs at 92% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 汐留→竹芝, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 1K ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. 1LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000 and 2LDK ¥350,000 to ¥360,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
